test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 30 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

SCENE : DMDBR :: STORY : XQNSR :: WRITE : ?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'SCENE is related to DMDBR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/257f0149410c9a915fc88e81c6aa869ed0059605657ba9bdeca2b4145b8273d2.png] 

For, 'STORY is related to XQNSR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55f1826bc37aca7e5f1230f73ee2c72fc573de4ade7dec7817539ada6ff2c4c5.png] 

Similarly, for 'WRITE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8384bafe62584a37c12daa36327403dbe570ab6f46c6e9d500032f77b9bfd83.png] 

So, '**WRITE**' will be related to '**DSHQV**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
